# Explorer's Pack (`equipment:explorers-pack`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 10 gp | **Weight:** 55 lb.
**Contents:** [Backpack](../equipment/backpack.md), [Bedroll](../equipment/bedroll.md), 2x [Oil](../equipment/oil.md), 10x [Rations](../equipment/rations.md), [Rope](../equipment/rope.md), [Tinderbox](../equipment/tinderbox.md), 10x [Torch](../equipment/torch.md), [Waterskin](../equipment/waterskin.md)

An Explorer’s Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.
